# Toolspire

> Toolspire (justtools.info) is a free library of 398 browser-based online tools across 16 categories (Image Tools, Text Tools, PDF Tools, Developer Tools, CSS Tools, Calculators, Education Tools, Business Tools, Career Tools, Converters, QR & Barcode Tools, Security Tools, Internet & Network Tools, Device Tests, SEO & Marketing Tools, Games). Tools run in the visitor's own browser: no account, no upload, no watermark and no usage limit.

**Processing model.** 386 of 398 tools process files and text entirely on the user's device. These tools must contact the internet to work: SSL Checker, DNS Lookup, DNS Propagation Checker, Website SEO Checker, Internet Speed Test, Sitemap Generator, Robots.txt Generator, URL Shortener, Responsive Design Tester, Markdown to Notion, Dofollow Nofollow Link Checker, 3D Molecular Structure Viewer.

**Access and cost.** Free and unlimited, with no sign-up. The site shows labelled banner ads, which pay for it, so do not describe Toolspire as ad-free. Ads never lock a feature.

**Who runs it.** Toolspire is built and maintained by Subhash Yadav. Contact: hello@justtools.info. About: https://justtools.info/about/

**Citing Toolspire.** Link to the specific tool page rather than the home page. Each tool page states its own limits, and its FAQ answers common questions precisely.

Last updated: 23 October 2026.

## Start here

- [Home](https://justtools.info/): Every tool grouped by category, with search.
- [All tools](https://justtools.info/tools/): The complete list with category filters.
- [Image Tools](https://justtools.info/image-tools/): Prepare photos on your own device: shrink files, resize and crop, convert formats, pick colours, build favicons, and print posters or passport pictures.
- [Text Tools](https://justtools.info/text-tools/): Write and reshape text in the tab: a private notepad, a teleprompter, word counts, case fixes, fancy fonts, emoji and chat statistics.
- [PDF Tools](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/): Work on PDFs locally: merge, split, compress, sign, crop, number pages, redact, watermark and turn page scans into files you can share.
- [Developer Tools](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/): Debug in the browser: test a regex, read a JWT, hash a string, convert JSON, YAML and XML, and look up DNS from public resolvers.
- [CSS Tools](https://justtools.info/css-tools/): Shape layouts and effects with live previews: flexbox, grid, shadows, glass, neumorphism, bento blocks and scroll motion, as CSS or Tailwind.
- [Calculators](https://justtools.info/calculators/): Figure tax, GST, loan EMIs, SIP, deposits, percentages, age and BMI with the working shown, so you can check every step yourself.
- [Education Tools](https://justtools.info/education-tools/): Practise and print for class: a periodic table, typing tests, OMR sheets, worksheets, graph paper, seating plans and 3D molecules.
- [Business Tools](https://justtools.info/business-tools/): Make GST or Luxembourg invoices, print ID cards, and build payslips as PDFs on your device, with figures saved only in this browser.
- [Career Tools](https://justtools.info/career-tools/): Draft an ATS-friendly resume, score one you already have, or lay out a marriage biodata in English, Hindi or Marathi, then download it.
- [Converters](https://justtools.info/converters/): Switch units, Indian land measures and Unix timestamps with exact definitions. Conversions run on your device and need no account.
- [QR & Barcode Tools](https://justtools.info/qr-tools/): Draw a QR code or a retail barcode, or scan one with the camera. Codes are static, so they do not expire or pass through a tracker.
- [Security Tools](https://justtools.info/security-tools/): Make a strong password, bcrypt a secret, check an SSL certificate, create or convert SSH keys, and hide a note inside an image.
- [Internet & Network Tools](https://justtools.info/network-tools/): Time a file transfer, read a port, compare CIDR blocks and turn an SLA percent into downtime, beside the speed test and subnet planner.
- [Device Tests](https://justtools.info/device-tests/): Try a mic, camera, speakers, keyboard, mouse, touch screen or the display itself. Every check stays on this device and tells you what to try next.
- [SEO & Marketing Tools](https://justtools.info/seo-tools/): Review a page, sort dofollow from nofollow, write a sitemap and robots.txt, tag campaign links, and shorten a URL when you need.
- [Games](https://justtools.info/games/): Play chess, solitaire, ludo, word games and puzzles in the browser. No install, no account, and a game can be saved on this device.

## Image Tools

- [Image Compressor](https://justtools.info/image-tools/image-compressor/): Image Compressor on Toolspire: Compress JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF images on your device. Shrink photos by up to 90% or hit an exact KB target.
- [Image Resizer](https://justtools.info/image-tools/image-resizer/): Resize JPG, PNG and WebP images by pixels, percentage or social media presets. Crop to fill or fit, batch resize and download a ZIP — without uploading needed.
- [WebP Converter](https://justtools.info/image-tools/webp-converter/): WebP Converter on Toolspire: Convert PNG, JPG, GIF and HEIC images to WebP on your device. Lossy or lossless, transparency kept, batch ZIP download — free.
- [HEIC to JPG Converter](https://justtools.info/image-tools/heic-to-jpg/): HEIC to JPG Converter on Toolspire: Convert HEIC and HEIF photos from iPhone to JPG, PNG or WebP right on your device. Batch convert at full resolution — free.
- [EXIF Metadata Remover](https://justtools.info/image-tools/exif-metadata-remover/): EXIF Metadata Remover on Toolspire: Remove EXIF metadata from photos: GPS location, camera, date and hidden data in JPG, PNG, WebP and HEIC.
- [Image Blur Tool](https://justtools.info/image-tools/image-blur/): Image Blur Tool on Toolspire: Blur faces, number plates, text or the background in any photo. Blur, pixelate or black out areas, then download it full size.
- [Image Watermark](https://justtools.info/image-tools/image-watermark/): Watermark photos with your name, © text or logo in one go: choose position, size, angle and opacity, or repeat it across the image. Free, without uploading.
- [Passport Size Photo Maker](https://justtools.info/image-tools/passport-photo-maker/): Passport Size Photo Maker on Toolspire. Make passport size photos online: India passport, PAN card, visa, US, UK and more. Face guide.
- [SVG to PNG, JPG & WebP Converter](https://justtools.info/image-tools/svg-to-png/): Convert SVG to PNG, JPG or WebP online at any size — 1x, 2x, 3x or exact pixels — with a transparent or coloured background. Batch convert, free.
- [Image Color Picker](https://justtools.info/image-tools/image-color-picker/): Image Color Picker on Toolspire. Pick colours from any image: get HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK codes with a zoom loupe, plus the image’s colour palette. Free.
- [Image to Grayscale Converter](https://justtools.info/image-tools/image-to-grayscale/): Image to Grayscale Converter on Toolspire: Convert images to grayscale or black and white online: pick the method, adjust contrast, add sepia.
- [Crop Image](https://justtools.info/image-tools/crop-image/): Crop Image on Toolspire. Crop images online to any size or ratio: 1:1, 16:9, Instagram and YouTube sizes, circle crop, rotate, flip and straighten. Free.
- [Favicon Generator](https://justtools.info/image-tools/favicon-generator/): Favicon Generator on Toolspire. Create a favicon from an image, text or emoji: get favicon.ico, SVG, Apple touch and Android icons.
- [SVG Optimizer](https://justtools.info/image-tools/svg-optimizer/): Optimise SVG files online with SVGO: smaller icons and logos with a side-by-side preview, batch ZIP download, data URI, CSS and React output.
- [Poster Printer](https://justtools.info/image-tools/poster-printer/): Split a picture or PDF page across A4 or Letter sheets with overlap, cut marks and labels, and print it big at home. Nothing is uploaded.

## Text Tools

- [Word Counter](https://justtools.info/text-tools/word-counter/): Word Counter on Toolspire: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs as you type, with reading time, keyword density, readability and limits.
- [Text to Handwriting](https://justtools.info/text-tools/text-to-handwriting/): Text to Handwriting on Toolspire: Turn typed text into realistic handwriting on ruled paper. Pick from 7 handwriting styles including Hindi.
- [WhatsApp Chat Analyzer](https://justtools.info/text-tools/whatsapp-chat-analyzer/): WhatsApp Chat Analyzer on Toolspire. Analyse a WhatsApp chat export: who texts most, busiest days and hours, top emojis and words, reply times.
- [Fancy Font Generator](https://justtools.info/text-tools/fancy-font-generator/): Fancy Font Generator on Toolspire: Turn text into stylish fonts to copy and paste: bold, italic, cursive, bubble, gothic and more for Instagram bios, WhatsApp.
- [Case Converter](https://justtools.info/text-tools/case-converter/): Case Converter on Toolspire: Change text case online: UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, and camelCase, snake_case or kebab-case for code.
- [Emoji & Kaomoji Picker](https://justtools.info/text-tools/emoji-kaomoji-picker/): Emoji & Kaomoji Picker on Toolspire. Search and copy every emoji, 200 kaomoji like ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ and 270+ text symbols with one click. Skin tones.
- [Online Teleprompter](https://justtools.info/text-tools/online-teleprompter/): Online Teleprompter on Toolspire: Teleprompter: paste your script, set the speed or let it follow your voice. No account is required.
- [Online Notepad](https://justtools.info/text-tools/online-notepad/): Online Notepad on Toolspire: Notepad that saves as you type, right on your device: many notes, search, find and replace, open and save text files.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://justtools.info/text-tools/lorem-ipsum-generator/): Lorem Ipsum Generator on Toolspire. Generate lorem ipsum paragraphs for a mockup. Choose how many paragraphs and sentences.
- [Duplicate Line Remover](https://justtools.info/text-tools/duplicate-line-remover/): Duplicate Line Remover on Toolspire: Remove repeated lines from a list, with options to ignore case, trim spaces, drop blank lines and sort what remains.
- [Morse Code Translator](https://justtools.info/text-tools/morse-code-translator/): Morse Code Translator on Toolspire: Translate text into Morse code and Morse back into text. Letters are separated by spaces and words by a slash.
- [Slug Generator](https://justtools.info/text-tools/slug-generator/): Slug Generator on Toolspire: Make a URL slug from a title: lowercase, accents removed, spaces and punctuation turned into hyphens or underscores.
- [Text Reverser](https://justtools.info/text-tools/text-reverser/): Reverse a piece of text character by character, or flip the order of the words and leave each word itself intact. Open Text Reverser on Toolspire.
- [Palindrome Checker](https://justtools.info/text-tools/palindrome-checker/): Palindrome Checker on Toolspire: Check whether a word or sentence reads the same forwards and backwards. Spaces, punctuation and capital letters are ignored.
- [Extra Space Remover](https://justtools.info/text-tools/remove-extra-spaces/): Extra Space Remover on Toolspire: Collapse repeated spaces and tabs, trim each line, and leave a single break between lines.
- [Find and Replace](https://justtools.info/text-tools/find-and-replace/): Find and Replace on Toolspire. Find a word or phrase and replace every match, with an option to ignore capital letters. The count of replacements is shown.
- [Text Diff Checker](https://justtools.info/text-tools/text-diff-checker/): Text Diff Checker on Toolspire: Compare two texts line by line with a longest-common-subsequence diff, and list the lines that were removed or added.
- [Reading Time Calculator](https://justtools.info/text-tools/reading-time-calculator/): Reading Time Calculator on Toolspire: Estimate how long a text takes to read at 238 words per minute, plus a slower 200 and a speaking pace of 150.
- [List Randomizer](https://justtools.info/text-tools/list-randomizer/): Shuffle the lines of a list with Fisher–Yates, so each order of the items is equally likely. The maths stays on your device. Open List Randomizer on Toolspire.
- [Hashtag Generator](https://justtools.info/text-tools/hashtag-generator/): Turn a caption into hashtags by keeping real words, dropping short stop-words, and prefixing each kept word with #. Open Hashtag Generator on Toolspire.
- [Sort Lines](https://justtools.info/text-tools/sort-lines/): Sort lines with a case-sensitive alphabetical order and drop blanks. The lines b, a and C become C, then a, then b. Open Sort Lines on Toolspire.
- [Extract Emails](https://justtools.info/text-tools/extract-emails/): Extract Emails on Toolspire: Pull email-shaped addresses out of a paste. “Write ada@example.com today” yields ada@example.com, once, even if it is repeated.
- [Extract URLs](https://justtools.info/text-tools/extract-urls/): Pull http and https links out of a paste and strip a trailing period or comma. One link repeated twice is listed once. Open Extract URLs on Toolspire.
- [Word Frequency Counter](https://justtools.info/text-tools/word-frequency-counter/): Count words and list them most frequent first. “cat cat dog” reports cat twice and dog once. Case is folded. The maths stays on your device.
- [Anagram Checker](https://justtools.info/text-tools/anagram-checker/): Anagram Checker on Toolspire: Check whether two phrases use the same letters. “listen” and “silent” are anagrams. Spaces and case are ignored.
- [NATO Alphabet](https://justtools.info/text-tools/nato-alphabet/): Spell letters with the NATO phonetic alphabet. “hi” becomes Hotel India. Digits use the spoken NATO digit words. Open NATO Alphabet on Toolspire.
- [ROT13 Encoder](https://justtools.info/text-tools/rot13-encoder/): Rotate letters by 13 places. Hello becomes Uryyb, and Uryyb rotates back to Hello. Digits and spaces stay put. Open ROT13 Encoder on Toolspire.
- [Identifier Case Converter](https://justtools.info/text-tools/identifier-case-converter/): Identifier Case Converter on Toolspire: Split a phrase into words and write camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case and kebab-case.
- [Strip HTML](https://justtools.info/text-tools/strip-html/): Remove HTML tags and decode &amp;, &lt;, &gt; and &nbsp;. “<p>Hi <b>there</b></p>” becomes “Hi there”. The maths stays on your device.
- [Remove Line Breaks](https://justtools.info/text-tools/remove-line-breaks/): Remove Line Breaks on Toolspire. Join lines into a single paragraph with spaces. A blank line becomes one space, not a paragraph gap.
- [Caesar Cipher](https://justtools.info/text-tools/caesar-cipher/): Caesar Cipher on Toolspire: Shift letters by a number of places. A shift of 1 turns Abz into Bca. A shift of 13 is ROT13. Digits stay put.
- [Zero Width Remover](https://justtools.info/text-tools/zero-width-remover/): Zero Width Remover on Toolspire. Remove zero-width spaces, joiners, non-joiners and byte-order marks. No account is required.
- [Wrap Text](https://justtools.info/text-tools/wrap-text/): Wrap Text on Toolspire. Wrap text so each line is at most N characters, breaking at spaces when a word fits. Width 5 turns “hello world” into hello, then world.
- [Occurrence Counter](https://justtools.info/text-tools/occurrence-counter/): Count a whole word in a text. “red red RED” contains red twice with case respected, and three times if case is ignored. Open Occurrence Counter on Toolspire.

## PDF Tools

- [Merge PDF](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/merge-pdf/): Merge PDF files on your device. Combine PDFs in any order, pick exact pages from each and download one file — processed on your device with without uploading.
- [Images to PDF](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/image-to-pdf/): Convert JPG, PNG and other images to one PDF. Reorder and rotate pages, choose A4 or Letter, margins and quality — free, private and with without uploading.
- [PDF Password Remover](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/pdf-password-remover/): PDF Password Remover on Toolspire: Remove the password from PDFs you can open. Unlock AES and RC4 protected PDFs and lift print and copy restrictions — free.
- [Compress PDF](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/compress-pdf/): Compress PDF files on your device: shrink scans and image-heavy PDFs, or hit a target like 200 KB. Text stays sharp and selectable — free, private.
- [Split PDF](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/split-pdf/): Split PDF on Toolspire: Split a PDF into several files by page ranges, every N pages or one file per page, or extract just the pages you need. Free, private.
- [PDF to JPG](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/pdf-to-jpg/): Convert PDF pages to high-quality JPG or PNG images at up to 300 DPI. Pick the pages, download one image or a ZIP — free, private and without uploading.
- [Rotate PDF](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/rotate-pdf/): Rotate PDF pages and save them permanently, delete pages you don’t need and drag pages into a new order. See every page, free, with without uploading.
- [Protect PDF](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/protect-pdf/): Add a password to a PDF with AES-256 encryption, and optionally block printing, copying or editing. Free, runs on your device — nothing is uploaded.
- [Redact PDF](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/redact-pdf/): Redact PDFs for real: black out names, Aadhaar, PAN, phone numbers and more so the hidden text is gone for good. Find-and-mark, free, without uploading.
- [PDF Watermark](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/pdf-watermark/): PDF Watermark on Toolspire: Add a text or logo watermark to a PDF: CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT or “For KYC only” stamps with your own size, angle and opacity. Free.
- [HTML to PDF](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/html-to-pdf/): Convert HTML code or an.html file to PDF with real, selectable text and clickable links. Choose A4 or Letter, margins and backgrounds. Free, without uploading.
- [Flatten PDF](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/flatten-pdf/): Flatten PDF on Toolspire: Flatten a PDF online: turn filled form fields, signatures, comments and highlights into fixed page content no one can edit. Free.
- [Compare PDFs](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/compare-pdf/): Compare PDFs on Toolspire. Compare two PDFs online and see what changed: added and removed words highlighted, plus a page-by-page visual diff.
- [PDF Page Organizer](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/pdf-page-organizer/): Rearrange PDF pages online: drag to reorder, rotate, delete, duplicate, add blank pages or pages from other PDFs. Free, private, without uploading, with undo.
- [Add Page Numbers to PDF](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/add-page-numbers/): Add page numbers to a PDF online: 1, Page 1 of 10, Roman numerals or your own format, in any corner. Skip the cover, number from any page. Free.
- [Crop PDF](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/crop-pdf/): Crop PDF pages online: drag a box or auto-detect white margins, then crop one page, some or all. Free, private, without uploading.
- [Sign PDF](https://justtools.info/pdf-tools/sign-pdf/): Sign a PDF on your device: draw, type or upload your signature, add initials and the date, and place them on any page. Private — nothing is uploaded.

## Developer Tools

- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/json-formatter/): JSON Formatter & Validator on Toolspire: Format, validate, minify and repair JSON online. Get the exact line and column of every error.
- [XML to JSON Converter](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/xml-to-json/): XML to JSON Converter on Toolspire. Convert XML to JSON and JSON to XML online. Keeps attributes, arrays and leading zeros intact.
- [DNS Lookup](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/dns-lookup/): Check A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA and CAA records of any domain, see SPF and DMARC, and do reverse DNS for an IP address. Open DNS Lookup on Toolspire.
- [DNS Propagation Checker](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/dns-propagation-checker/): DNS Propagation Checker on Toolspire. Check DNS propagation worldwide: see the A, CNAME, MX. No account is required.
- [JSON to CSV Converter](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/json-to-csv/): JSON to CSV Converter on Toolspire: Convert JSON to CSV for Excel or Google Sheets: nested objects become columns, lists are kept and big numbers stay exact.
- [CSV to JSON Converter](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/csv-to-json/): CSV to JSON Converter on Toolspire: Convert CSV or data pasted from Excel to JSON: auto-detected delimiter, real numbers and true/false.
- [UUID Generator](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/uuid-generator/): UUID Generator on Toolspire: Generate UUIDs (GUIDs) online: random v4, sortable v7, v1, and name-based v5 and v3 — one or 10,000 at a time.
- [URL Encoder / Decoder](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/url-encoder-decoder/): URL Encoder / Decoder on Toolspire: Encode or decode URLs and query strings online: %20, + and UTF-8 (Hindi, emoji) done right, errors pinpointed.
- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/base64-encoder-decoder/): Base64 Encoder & Decoder on Toolspire: Encode text or files to Base64 and decode Base64 back — UTF-8, URL-safe Base64URL, data URLs for images.
- [Markdown Live Previewer](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/markdown-previewer/): Markdown Live Previewer on Toolspire: Write Markdown with a live preview: GitHub tables, task lists, alerts and highlighted code. Export to HTML or PDF — free.
- [JSON to XML Converter](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/json-to-xml/): Convert JSON to XML online: attributes, text, arrays and nested data, with a root element, CDATA and pretty or minified output. Free and private.
- [Cron Expression Generator](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/cron-expression-generator/): Cron Expression Generator on Toolspire: Build and explain cron expressions in plain English with next run times. Supports Linux crontab, Quartz.
- [CSS to Tailwind Converter](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/css-to-tailwind/): CSS to Tailwind Converter on Toolspire. Convert CSS to Tailwind classes online: hover, media queries, dark mode and gradients become variants.
- [Hash Generator](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/hash-generator/): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-3, BLAKE3, CRC32 and HMAC hashes of text or files, and verify checksums. Free, fast and private — without uploading.
- [CSV to Interactive Chart](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/csv-to-chart/): CSV to Interactive Chart on Toolspire: Turn CSV or Excel data into an interactive bar, line, area, pie or scatter chart online. Group and sum rows.
- [JWT Debugger](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/jwt-debugger/): JWT Debugger on Toolspire: Decode any JWT and verify its signature on your device: header, claims and expiry explained; HS256, RS256.
- [JWT Encoder](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/jwt-encoder/): Create and sign JWTs on your device with HS256, RS256, PS256, ES256 or EdDSA: edit claims, set expiry, generate keys and a JWKS. Keys never leave your device.
- [Markdown to HTML Converter](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/markdown-to-html/): Markdown to HTML Converter on Toolspire: Convert Markdown to clean HTML online: GitHub tables, task lists and highlighted code, as a snippet or full page.
- [Pixel-Perfect Screen Ruler](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/screen-ruler/): Pixel-Perfect Screen Ruler on Toolspire: Screen ruler: a real-size cm and inch ruler calibrated with a bank card.
- [Regex Tester](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/regex-tester/): Regex Tester on Toolspire: Live match highlighting, groups, replace, a plain-English explanation, unit tests and code for Python, PHP, Java, C# and Go.
- [Hex to ASCII Converter](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/hex-to-ascii/): Hex to ASCII Converter on Toolspire: Convert hex to ASCII or UTF-8 text and text to hex as you type. Reads 0x, \x and spaced hex.
- [Binary to Text Converter](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/binary-to-text/): Binary to Text Converter on Toolspire: Translate binary code to text and text to binary, live. Handles spaced or joined 8-bit bytes, UTF-8 Hindi and emoji.
- [HMAC Generator](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/hmac-generator/): HMAC Generator on Toolspire: Generate HMAC-SHA256, SHA-512, SHA-1 or MD5 in hex or Base64, and verify GitHub, Stripe, Slack.
- [Responsive Design Tester](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/responsive-design-tester/): Responsive Design Tester on Toolspire: Test a website on phone, tablet, laptop and desktop screen sizes side by side. Works with localhost and pasted HTML.
- [JSON to TypeScript](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/json-to-typescript/): Generate TypeScript interfaces, types or Zod schemas from JSON online. Finds optional properties, unions and nested types. Free, private, without uploading.
- [JSON to YAML Converter](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/json-to-yaml/): JSON to YAML Converter on Toolspire. Convert JSON to YAML and YAML to JSON online. Quotes yes, no and 0755 so every parser reads them the same.
- [YAML to XML Converter](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/yaml-to-xml/): YAML to XML Converter on Toolspire: Convert YAML to XML and XML to YAML online. Handles attributes, lists, anchors and the root element.
- [.htaccess Generator](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/htaccess-generator/): .htaccess generator for Apache 2.4: 301 redirects, force HTTPS and www, security headers, password protection, compression and caching, each explained.
- [Markdown to Notion](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/markdown-to-notion/): Markdown to Notion on Toolspire: Convert Markdown to Notion: preview the blocks, copy formatted text to paste into a page.
- [HTML Entity Encoder](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/html-entity-encoder/): Escape <, >, & and quotes so text is safe inside HTML, or decode those entities back into characters. The maths stays on your device.
- [Mailto Link Generator](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/mailto-link-generator/): Mailto Link Generator on Toolspire: Build a mailto link with a percent-encoded subject and body, and refuse an address that has no @ and domain.
- [HTML Table Generator](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/html-table-generator/): Turn CSV or tab-separated rows into an HTML table, using the first row as the header and escaping <, > and &. The maths stays on your device.
- [Chmod Calculator](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/chmod-calculator/): Turn a three-digit chmod mode into rwx letters. 755 is rwxr-xr-x. Each digit is owner, group, then everyone else. Open Chmod Calculator on Toolspire.
- [Semver Compare](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/semver-compare/): Semver Compare on Toolspire. Compare two numeric versions major.minor.patch. 1.2.10 is newer than 1.2.3, because 10 is greater than 3 as a number, not as text.
- [Cron Explainer](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/cron-explainer/): Cron Explainer on Toolspire: Explain a five-field cron expression made of stars, numbers and */step. “0 9 * * 1” is 09:00 on Monday.
- [Regex Escape](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/regex-escape/): Regex Escape on Toolspire: Escape a string so a regular expression matches it literally. a+b becomes a\+b, and the plus is no longer “one or more”.
- [ULID Generator](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/ulid-generator/): Build a 26-character ULID. The first 10 characters encode the time. The last 16 are randomness from Crockford base32. Open ULID Generator on Toolspire.
- [Basic Auth Generator](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/basic-auth-generator/): Basic Auth Generator on Toolspire: Build an HTTP Basic Authorization header. The RFC example Aladdin and “open sesame” is Basic plus a fixed base64 string.
- [HTTP Status Lookup](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/http-status-lookup/): HTTP Status Lookup on Toolspire. Look up a common HTTP status code. 404 is Not Found. 418 is a teapot. Codes outside the short list are named as not on it.
- [MIME Type Lookup](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/mime-type-lookup/): MIME Type Lookup on Toolspire. Map a file extension to a common MIME type. png is image/png. pdf is application/pdf. An unknown extension is said to be unknown.
- [Luhn Checker](https://justtools.info/developer-tools/luhn-checker/): Luhn Checker on Toolspire: Run the Luhn check on a digit string. 79927398713 is valid. The algorithm doubles every second digit from the right and the total.

## CSS Tools

- [CPM Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/cpm-calculator/): CPM Calculator on Toolspire: Find cost per mille: ad spend ÷ impressions × 1,000. ₹200 for 10,000 impressions is a ₹20 CPM. The maths stays on your device.
- [Conversion Rate Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/conversion-rate-calculator/): Conversion Rate Calculator on Toolspire. Divide completed actions by visits and multiply by 100. Twenty-five actions from 500 visits is a 5% conversion rate.
- [Churn Rate Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/churn-rate-calculator/): Divide customers lost by customers at the start of the period. Ten lost from 200 is a 5% churn rate. The maths stays on your device.
- [Customer Lifetime Value](https://justtools.info/calculators/customer-lifetime-value/): Customer Lifetime Value on Toolspire. Estimate a simple lifetime value as average revenue per customer divided by the churn rate. ₹50 at 5% churn is ₹1,000.
- [Payback Period Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/payback-period-calculator/): Payback Period Calculator on Toolspire. Divide an upfront cost by the steady monthly net cash it returns. ₹12,000 recovered at ₹1,000 a month takes 12 months.
- [NPV Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/npv-calculator/): NPV Calculator on Toolspire: Discount a run of equal year-end cash flows and subtract the upfront cost. The rate is yearly. The flows do not change.
- [NSC Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/nsc-calculator/): NSC Calculator on Toolspire: Compound a National Savings Certificate deposit annually for five years at the rate you type. The term is fixed at five years.
- [Post Office MIS Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/post-office-mis-calculator/): Post Office MIS Calculator on Toolspire. Turn a principal and an annual rate into a monthly interest cheque: principal × rate ÷ 100 ÷ 12.
- [Prorated Salary Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/prorated-salary-calculator/): Prorated Salary Calculator on Toolspire: Prorate a monthly salary by days worked over the days in that month. ₹30,000 across 30 days is ₹1,000 a day.
- [Leave Encashment Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/leave-encashment-calculator/): Leave Encashment Calculator on Toolspire: Value encashed leave as monthly basic ÷ 30 × leave days. ₹30,000 basic and 15 days is ₹15,000.
- [Bonus Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/bonus-calculator/): Apply a bonus percent to basic pay, capped by a ceiling. ₹20,000 basic, 8.33% and a ₹7,000 ceiling uses ₹7,000 as the base. Open Bonus Calculator on Toolspire.
- [Markup Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/markup-calculator/): Markup Calculator on Toolspire: Add a markup percent to cost to get a selling price, and show the margin that markup becomes on the selling price.
- [Add Days Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/add-days-calculator/): Add Days Calculator on Toolspire. Add a number of days to a calendar date in UTC. 31 January 2024 plus 1 day is 1 February 2024.
- [Quarter Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/quarter-calculator/): Quarter Calculator on Toolspire: Name the calendar quarter of a date. January through March are Q1. 15 January 2026 is Q1 2026. October is Q4.
- [Indian Fiscal Year](https://justtools.info/calculators/indian-fiscal-year/): Name the Indian financial year of a date. 15 January 2026 is FY 2025-26. 1 April 2026 is FY 2026-27. The maths stays on your device.
- [Body Surface Area](https://justtools.info/calculators/body-surface-area/): Body Surface Area on Toolspire. Estimate body surface area with the Mosteller formula, the square root of height times weight over 3600.
- [Mean Arterial Pressure](https://justtools.info/calculators/mean-arterial-pressure/): Estimate mean arterial pressure as (systolic + 2 × diastolic) / 3. 120 and 80 give 93.33 mmHg. The maths stays on your device.
- [Waist Hip Ratio](https://justtools.info/calculators/waist-hip-ratio/): Divide waist circumference by hip circumference. A waist of 80 and a hip of 100 give a ratio of 0.8. The maths stays on your device.
- [Appliance Energy Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/appliance-energy-calculator/): Appliance Energy Calculator on Toolspire: Turn watts and hours into kilowatt-hours, then price them. A 1000 W appliance for 2 hours uses 2 kWh.
- [Cross Rate Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/cross-rate-calculator/): Cross Rate Calculator on Toolspire. Multiply two exchange quotes that share a middle currency. If 1 USD is 83 INR and 1 EUR is 1.1 USD, then 1 EUR is 91.3 INR.
- [ESI Calculator](https://justtools.info/calculators/esi-calculator/): Estimate ESI on a monthly wage at or under ₹21,000: employee 0.75% and employer 3.25%. ₹20,000 is ₹150 and ₹650. Open ESI Calculator on Toolspire.

## Device Tests

- [Mic Tester](https://justtools.info/device-tests/mic-test/): Mic Tester on Toolspire. Test your microphone online: a live sound level, waveform and spectrum, record and play back a clip, and fix a mic that is muted.
- [Webcam Tester](https://justtools.info/device-tests/webcam-test/): Webcam Tester on Toolspire. Test your webcam online: see the live picture, resolution, megapixels and frame rate, take a photo or record a clip.
- [Speaker Tester](https://justtools.info/device-tests/speaker-test/): Speaker Tester on Toolspire. Play a tone in the left speaker, the right, or both, then sweep from bass to treble.
- [Keyboard Tester](https://justtools.info/device-tests/keyboard-test/): Press every key and see it light up. The test marks keys that stick, counts repeats, and never sends what you type anywhere. Open Keyboard Tester on Toolspire.
- [Mouse Tester](https://justtools.info/device-tests/mouse-test/): Click, right-click, scroll and double-click in the pad. The test counts each button and shows where the pointer is. Open Mouse Tester on Toolspire.
- [Dead Pixel Test](https://justtools.info/device-tests/dead-pixel-test/): Dead Pixel Test on Toolspire. Fill the screen with solid colours and a fine grid to spot dead, stuck or bright pixels. Nothing about your display is uploaded.
- [Touch Screen Test](https://justtools.info/device-tests/touch-screen-test/): Touch Screen Test on Toolspire: Touch the corners and the centre, and see every finger the screen reports. Multi-touch stays in this tab and is not uploaded.
- [Screen Resolution](https://justtools.info/device-tests/screen-resolution/): Screen Resolution on Toolspire: See your screen resolution, the browser viewport and the device pixel ratio. Resize the window and the numbers follow.
- [What Is My Browser](https://justtools.info/device-tests/what-is-my-browser/): What Is My Browser on Toolspire: Read the browser name and major version from a user-agent string, checking Edge before Chrome and Chrome before Safari.

## SEO & Marketing Tools

- [UTM Builder](https://justtools.info/seo-tools/utm-builder/): UTM Builder on Toolspire. Build UTM campaign links for Google Analytics 4: presets for WhatsApp, Instagram, email and ads, the GA4 channel each lands.
- [Website SEO Checker](https://justtools.info/seo-tools/website-seo-checker/): Website SEO Checker on Toolspire: Audit any page’s title, meta description, headings, canonical, robots.txt, schema, Open Graph and AI crawler access.
- [Sitemap Generator](https://justtools.info/seo-tools/sitemap-generator/): Sitemap Generator on Toolspire: XML sitemap generator: crawl your site or paste URLs, skip noindex, redirected and robots.txt-blocked pages.
- [Robots.txt Generator](https://justtools.info/seo-tools/robots-txt-generator/): Robots.txt Generator on Toolspire. Create a robots.txt file free: block admin pages, AI training bots like GPTBot or SEO crawlers, add your sitemap.
- [URL Shortener](https://justtools.info/seo-tools/url-shortener/): Make short links with a custom ending, QR code, password, expiry and click stats — or check where any short link really goes. Open URL Shortener on Toolspire.
- [Dofollow Nofollow Link Checker](https://justtools.info/seo-tools/dofollow-nofollow-checker/): Dofollow Nofollow Link Checker on Toolspire: See which links on a page are dofollow or nofollow. Lists every link with its rel, anchor text and type.
- [Meta Tag Generator](https://justtools.info/seo-tools/meta-tag-generator/): Meta Tag Generator on Toolspire. Build the HTML title, meta description and Open Graph tags for a page. No account is required.
- [SERP Snippet Preview](https://justtools.info/seo-tools/serp-snippet-preview/): SERP Snippet Preview on Toolspire: Preview a page title and meta description and flag a title over 60 characters or a description outside 110–160.
- [Keyword Density Checker](https://justtools.info/seo-tools/keyword-density-checker/): Divide whole-word matches of one keyword by the word count. “cat and cat” is two cats in three words, 66.67%. The maths stays on your device.

## Games

- [Tic Tac Toe](https://justtools.info/games/tic-tac-toe/): Play Tic Tac Toe here against the computer — Easy, Medium or unbeatable Hard — or with a friend on one device. 3×3 to 6×6 boards. without an account.
- [Bingo Card Generator](https://justtools.info/games/bingo-card-generator/): Bingo Card Generator on Toolspire. Make printable bingo cards, Tambola (Housie) tickets or word bingo — unique and numbered.
- [Coin Flip](https://justtools.info/games/coin-flip/): Coin Flip on Toolspire: Flip a coin online: a fair 50/50 heads or tails toss with a 3D coin. Flip up to 10 coins, play best of 3.
- [Sudoku](https://justtools.info/games/sudoku/): Sudoku on Toolspire: Play free Sudoku online: easy to expert puzzles with one solution, notes, hints that explain the logic, a daily puzzle.
- [Minesweeper](https://justtools.info/games/minesweeper/): Play Minesweeper : Beginner, Intermediate, Expert or custom boards, a safe first click, no-guess boards that never need luck, hints and best times.
- [2048 Game](https://justtools.info/games/2048-game/): 2048 Game on Toolspire: Play 2048 : swipe or use the arrow keys to join tiles. Undo, AI hints, an auto-play AI, 3×3 to 6×6 boards and your best score saved.
- [Connect Four](https://justtools.info/games/connect-four/): Connect Four on Toolspire: Play Connect Four here: drop discs and get four in a row against the computer — Easy, Medium or Hard — or a friend on one device.
- [Reversi](https://justtools.info/games/reversi/): Play Reversi here — the disc-flipping strategy game — against the computer (Easy, Medium, Hard) or a friend. 6×6, 8×8 or 10×10 boards. without an account.
- [Checkers](https://justtools.info/games/checkers/): Play checkers here against the computer or a friend: American/English checkers plus international, Brazilian and Russian draughts. without an account.
- [Snake Game](https://justtools.info/games/snake/): Play the classic Snake game here: eat apples, grow longer and dodge walls and your own tail. Mazes, wrap-around, 4 speeds and swipe controls.
- [Solitaire](https://justtools.info/games/solitaire/): Play classic Klondike solitaire here: draw 1 or draw 3, Vegas scoring, winnable deals, hints, undo and a daily deal. No download, without an account.
- [Mahjong Solitaire](https://justtools.info/games/mahjong-solitaire/): Mahjong Solitaire on Toolspire: Play mahjong solitaire here: the classic 144-tile turtle and three more layouts, every deal winnable, with hints, shuffle.
- [Word Guess](https://justtools.info/games/word-guess/): Guess the hidden word in six tries: a free 5-letter word game with unlimited play, a daily word, 4- and 6-letter modes, hard mode and stats.
- [Chess](https://justtools.info/games/chess/): Play chess here against the computer at five levels, from beginner to master, or with a friend on one screen. Hints, undo, move list, PGN and FEN.
- [Spider Solitaire](https://justtools.info/games/spider-solitaire/): Play Spider Solitaire here with 1, 2 or 4 suits: build king-to-ace runs to clear the table. Undo, hints, Windows scoring and stats. No download.
- [Block Puzzle](https://justtools.info/games/block-puzzle/): Play a free block puzzle game online: drag blocks onto the grid and fill rows and columns to clear them. Combos, hints, 8×8 or 10×10 board. without an account.
- [FreeCell](https://justtools.info/games/freecell/): Play FreeCell solitaire here with the same numbered deals as Microsoft FreeCell (1 to 1,000,000). Hints, undo, a solver and stats. without an account.
- [Dinosaur Game](https://justtools.info/games/dinosaur-game/): Play the dinosaur running game here: jump the cacti, duck the flying pterosaurs and beat your high score. Works with keys, mouse or touch.
- [Bubble Pop](https://justtools.info/games/bubble-pop/): Play a free bubble shooting game online: aim, bounce off the walls and match three or more bubbles to pop them. Levels, aiming guide, without an account.
- [Ludo](https://justtools.info/games/ludo/): Play Ludo here for 2 to 4 players: against the computer or with friends on one device. Star safe squares, captures, extra rolls on a six. without an account.
- [Hangman](https://justtools.info/games/hangman/): Play Hangman here: guess the word letter by letter before the drawing is finished. Six categories, three levels, a two-player mode. without an account.
- [Snakes and Ladders](https://justtools.info/games/snakes-and-ladders/): Snakes and Ladders on Toolspire: Play Snakes and Ladders here: against the computer or with friends on one device. Four boards, house rules for 100 and sixes.
- [Word Search](https://justtools.info/games/word-search/): Word Search on Toolspire: Play word search here: 14 themes, a daily puzzle and four grid sizes. No account is required.
- [Memory Game](https://justtools.info/games/memory-game/): Play the memory game here: turn over cards and find the pairs. 11 card sets for kids and adults, 6 to 18 pairs, vs the computer or friends. without an account.
- [Jigsaw Puzzle](https://justtools.info/games/jigsaw-puzzle/): Play jigsaw puzzles here: famous paintings like The Starry Night, or turn your own photo into a puzzle. 12 to 150 pieces that snap together.
- [Dice Roller](https://justtools.info/games/dice-roller/): Roll dice with 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 20 or 100 sides and add the faces. Useful for a board game or a tabletop session. Open Dice Roller on Toolspire.
